# Hormelz — 8 Directional 2DHD Pixel Art Animated Character

Original source: https://hormelz.itch.io/8-directional-char
License: Creative Commons Zero v1.0 Universal (CC0-1.0)
Commercial use: allowed
Attribution: not required
Generative AI: source page states none used
Canvas size: 256x256 per frame
Direction set: Up, UpRight, Right, DownRight, Down, DownLeft, Left, UpLeft

- Walk
- Run
- Fireball
- Damaged

The source page lists 13 animations and provides the pack as name-your-own-price/free.
Build workflow retrieves matching public PNG mirrors for prototype integration while this file records the original creator and license source.
